title: PM-JANMAN Abhiyan (Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan):
summary: Schemes — PM-JANMAN Abhiyan (Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan):

items: Launched on November 15, 2023, with a budget of ₹24,000 crore for 3 years. It aims to uplift
Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs), targeting a population of 28 lakh in 18 states
 Integrating PVTG communities into the mainstream.
 Providing access to education, healthcare, housing, water, sanitation, roads, and livelihood.
 Empowering women and promoting cultural preservation.
Nine ministries are involved in this nationwide initiative, focusing on socio-economic development
and legal rights of tribal communities.
